thesis: The speakers explain that their firm was founded because they viewed themselves as independent advisors who needed to broaden their toolkit beyond standard stocks and bonds to protect capital in challenging market environments. They argue that mathematically, the best way to achieve attractive long-term returns with minimal risk is to own multiple return streams that move independently of one another.
